title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says

title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
description: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.

title: Bitmine Buys More Ethereum as Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish

title: Binance Misses Monthly Luna Classic Burn for First Time Since 2023
description: LUNC holders are waiting for Binance’s November burn, but it hasn’t arrived as the exchange recovers from a record $6.3 billion hack.

title: CrowdStrike Launches AI Agent 'Kill Switch,' Plans to Acquire Fiddler AI
description: CrowdStrike's new kill switch lets security teams cut off unauthorized AI agents through a gateway, while its planned Fiddler acquisition aims to make autonomous software easier to monitor and audit.
